key_findings_zh: 摘要 麻疹在全球范围内再次流行,尽管疫苗可预防,但严重病例可进展为对常规支持无反应的心肺衰竭。本研究旨在确定体外膜肺氧合(ECMO)是否适用于麻疹患儿。本研究为回顾性病例系列,研究对象为一家三级儿科重症监护病房(PICU)中所有在2025年8月至2026年5月暴发期间接受ECMO治疗的、年龄小于18岁的实验室确诊麻疹患儿。共有49名麻疹患儿被收治入PICU,其中10名接受了ECMO治疗。5名为男性;中位年龄为11个月(IQR,10–24),且无一例完成年龄合适的疫苗接种。ECMO的适应症包括败血性休克或心肺衰竭(n=5)、伴有败血性休克的急性呼吸窘迫综合征(n=2)、低氧性呼吸衰竭(n=2)以及疑似心肌炎(n=1)。7名患儿接受了静脉动脉ECMO,1名接受了静脉-静脉动脉ECMO,2名接受了静脉静脉ECMO。5名患儿在ECMO前存在菌血症,8名存在阳性痰培养。前5名患者中有3例发展为热带念珠菌血症,而在接受导管插入时使用抗真菌预防措施后,后续5名患者中未出现念珠菌血症。9名评估的患儿中有7名存在左心室功能障碍,其中4名需要减压,8名接受影像学检查的患儿中有4名出现异常影像。6名患儿(60%)存活至出院。结论:在麻疹相关的心肺衰竭中,ECMO是可行的,并可能挽救生命,其生存率与其他高危儿科适应症相当,但病情复杂,伴有细菌和真菌合并感染、心脏功能障碍和神经系统损伤。这些资源密集型的临床表现仅出现在未接种疫苗的儿童中,并且是可预防的,这突显了麻疹 疫苗接种接种覆盖率作为公共卫生优先事项的重要性。已知信息:• 麻疹在全球范围内再次流行,可导致儿童严重的呼吸、心脏和免疫并发症。• 麻疹引发的免疫抑制使患儿易发生继发性细菌和真菌感染。新发现:• 首次报道的麻疹患儿ECMO治疗系列:ECMO是可行的,生存率为60%,但伴有合并感染、心脏功能障碍和神经系统损伤。• 在ECMO导管插入时使用抗真菌预防措施与本队列研究中念珠菌血症的消除相关。 [10.1007/s00431-026-07467-4]
本研究发现,在2025年美国德克萨斯州暴发期间,基因型D8在北美麻疹病毒的广泛菌株多样性中有所扩展。 [10.3201/eid3210.260494]
MeV RNA在液相中广泛分布,但在固体中最为集中。污水中的麻疹病毒信号与临床病例呈正相关,但在按流行病学周划分时未能提供麻疹病毒传播变化的早期预警。 [10.3201/eid3210.260092]
综述得出结论:由于疫苗犹豫情绪的上升和疫苗接种接种率的下降,育龄女性中麻疹的感染率增加,从而提高了妊娠期和先天性麻疹的风险。同时,综述还强调了了解先天性麻疹的临床过程和管理方法的重要性。 [10.1542/neo.27-10-054]
与及时 MCV1 疫苗接种 相关的特征在城市和农村地区有所不同,但共同主题包括护理人员免疫意识和服务提供方面的提高。 [10.1016/j.jvacx.2026.100892]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Of 49 children with measles admitted to the PICU, 10 received ECMO. Seven received venoarterial, 1 veno-venoarterial, and 2 venovenous ECMO. Bacteremia preceded ECMO in 5 children and positive sputum culture in 8. [10.1007/s00431-026-07467-4]
The study identified the expansion of genotype D8 within the broader strain diversity of measles virus in North America during the 2025 outbreak in Texas, USA. [10.3201/eid3210.260494]

MeV RNA was broadly distributed in the liquid phase but most concentrated in the solids. The measles virus signal in wastewater was positively associated with clinical cases but did not provide early alert of changes in measles incidence when resolved by epidemiologic week. [10.3201/eid3210.260092]

The review concludes that the incidence of measles among women of childbearing age has increased due to vaccine hesitancy and declining vaccination rates, thereby increasing the risk of gestational and congenital measles. [10.1542/neo.27-10-054]

Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination differed in urban and rural areas, but common themes included increased caregiver immunization awareness and service delivery aspects. [10.1016/j.jvacx.2026.100892]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.

news.headline_zh: 麻疹病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期麻疹病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 麻疹 暴发 已被报告,美国有 3,886 例确诊病例,宾夕法尼亚州的病例接近 1,000 例。麻疹病毒 与因对免疫细胞的影响而增加传染病易感性有关。 [news-4e53bda379cac2d8]
根据CDC数据,美国2026年麻疹病例连续第二年突破2000例。这一情况已由CDC确认并由ABC新闻报道。 [news-6a02c4cefcd18d59]
文章报道称,2026年美国麻疹病例数预计将超过2025年全年的总病例数。这一趋势已由CDC数据确认,截至2026年7月9日,美国已报告2,231例病例,仅比2025年的2,289例少58例。该事件是一项确认的公共卫生趋势。 [news-f130bc00dc96b34c]
麻疹 正在以过去 35 年未见的水平传播,其中佐治亚州一家托儿所相关的 暴发 导致 10 名儿童感染(N5,N6)。尽管 疫苗接种 在预防 麻疹 方面至关重要,但 CDC 并未将其作为返校的重要信息强调(N11)。 [news-9541daaca297e1f2]
宾夕法尼亚州报告了 2026 年第五例与 麻疹 相关的死亡,该州正在进行的 麻疹 确诊病例已达到 39 个县的 943 例,176 例住院治疗。宾夕法尼亚州卫生部证实,一名未接种疫苗的居民因 麻疹 检测呈阳性而死亡。 [news-b072af56eade8f74]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Measles virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Measles outbreaks have been reported, with the US having 3,886 confirmed infections and Pennsylvania nearing 1,000 cases. The measles virus is linked to increased vulnerability to infectious diseases due to its impact on immune cells. [news-4e53bda379cac2d8]
Measles cases in the United States have surpassed 2,000 for the second consecutive year, according to CDC data. This is confirmed by the CDC and reported by ABC News. [news-6a02c4cefcd18d59]

The article reports that measles cases in 2026 are set to surpass the total reported for all of 2025. This is confirmed by CDC data showing 2,231 cases as of July 9, 2026, which is just 58 short of the 2,289 cases reported in 2025. The event is a confirmed public health trend. [news-f130bc00dc96b34c]

Measles is spreading at a level not seen in 35 years, with an outbreak linked to a daycare in Georgia resulting in 10 child infections (N5, N6). The CDC has not emphasized vaccination as a key back-to-school message, despite its importance in preventing measles (N11). [news-9541daaca297e1f2]

Pennsylvania reported its fifth measles-associated death of 2026, with the state’s ongoing outbreak reaching 943 confirmed cases across 39 counties and 176 hospitalizations. The death was confirmed by the Pennsylvania Department of Health for an unvaccinated resident who tested positive for measles. [news-b072af56eade8f74]

papers.title: Congenital Measles: A Review
papers.abstract: Since measles was declared "eliminated" in the United States following widespread vaccination, congenital measles has been exceedingly rare. As a result, many neonatal clinicians are unlikely to have encountered a case during or after training. However, with the rise of vaccine hesitancy and declining vaccination rates, the incidence of measles among women of childbearing age, and thus the risk of gestational and congenital measles, has increased. Because the incidence of measles incidence is expected to continue to rise, it is imperative that neonatal clinicians be familiar with the presentation, complications, and management of congenital measles. In this review, we summarize the historical epidemiology of congenital measles and provide current and future epidemiological predictions in the context of declining vaccinations. We also describe the clinical course and general management of congenital measles.

papers.title: Pediatric Measles Resurgence: Implications for Acute and Critical Care Nursing Practice
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The United States declared endemic measles eliminated in 2000. However, outbreaks continued, with resurgences in 2019 and 2025. In 2025, more than 2200 cases across 48 outbreaks, the most since 1992, were reported. In the first half of 2026, 2073 cases were reported. Declining measles, mumps, and rubella vaccination rates have increased susceptibility among children. Acute and critical care nurses are central to early recognition and management of measles for optimal outcomes. OBJECTIVE: To summarize current evidence on measles epidemiology, pathophysiology, clinical presentation, complications, treatment strategies, and acute and critical care nursing implications, emphasizing preparedness amid rising case numbers. METHODS: A literature review was conducted using PubMed and CINAHL databases and websites of Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, World Health Organization, professional organizations, and pediatric hospitals. English-language sources published from 2015 to August 2025 were prioritized; relevant earlier studies were included. Reference lists were searched for additional articles. DATA SYNTHESIS: Measles is among the most contagious human diseases. Typical features include fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and morbilliform rash. Severe respiratory and neurological complications may require critical care hospitalization. Complications like encephalitis may present weeks to years after acute infection. Management remains supportive, with vitamin A supplementation recommended. Acute and critical care nursing priorities include early recognition, isolation precautions, specimen collection, respiratory and hemodynamic support, neurological monitoring, serial assessments, hydration, nutrition, and caregiver education. CONCLUSION: Measles is resurging in the United States despite being vaccine preventable. Nurse preparedness, including knowledge of clinical features, complications, and infection control, is essential to mitigate morbidity and mortality and to support outbreak prevention.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 通过PubMed和CINAHL数据库,以及疾病控制与预防中心、世界卫生组织、专业组织和儿科医院的网站进行了文献综述。优先考虑2015年至2025年8月期间发表的英文文献,并纳入相关早期研究。还检索了参考文献列表以获取更多文章。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 麻疹在美国出现回升,尽管其是可预防的疾病。麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹的发病率下降使儿童群体更容易感染。麻疹是人类最具有传染性的疾病之一,典型特征包括发热、咳嗽、流涕、结膜炎和麻疹样皮疹。严重的呼吸系统和神经系统并发症可能需要重症监护住院治疗,如脑炎等并发症可能在急性感染后数周至数年才出现。治疗仍以支持性为主,推荐补充维生素A。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 本综述未报告与麻疹相关的具体争议或证据缺口。然而,它指出麻疹病例的回升凸显了提高疫苗接种率和护士准备度的必要性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 急性及重症护理护理的优先事项包括早期识别、隔离预防、样本采集、呼吸和血流动力学支持、神经系统监测、连续评估、补液、营养支持以及照顾者教育。护士的准备度,包括对临床特征、并发症和感染控制的知识,对于减少发病率和死亡率以及支持疫情预防至关重要。

English-language sources published from 2015 to August 2025 were prioritized; relevant earlier studies were included. Reference lists were searched for additional articles. DATA SYNTHESIS: Measles is among the most contagious human diseases. Typical features include fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and morbilliform rash. Severe respiratory and neurological complications may require critical care hospitalization. Complications like encephalitis may present weeks to years after acute infection. Management remains supportive, with vitamin A supplementation recommended. Acute and critical care nursing priorities include early recognition, isolation precautions, specimen collection, respiratory and hemodynamic support, neurological monitoring, serial assessments, hydration, nutrition, and caregiver education. CONCLUSION: Measles is resurging in the United States despite being vaccine preventable. Nurse preparedness, including knowledge of clinical features, complications, and infection control, is essential to mitigate morbidity and mortality and to support outbreak prevention.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:美国于2000年宣布麻疹疫情已消除。然而,麻疹疫情持续存在,2019年和2025年出现了回升。2025年,48个州报告了超过2200例麻疹病例,这是自1992年以来的最高水平。2026年上半年报告了2073例病例。麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹的发病率下降,使儿童群体更容易感染。急性及重症护理护士在早期识别和管理麻疹方面起着核心作用,以实现最佳治疗效果。目的:总结当前关于麻疹的流行病学、发病机制、临床表现、并发症、监测策略以及对急性及重症护理护理实践的影响的证据,强调在病例数量上升的情况下提高准备度的重要性。方法:通过PubMed和CINAHL数据库,以及疾病控制与预防中心、世界卫生组织、专业组织和儿科医院的网站进行文献综述。优先考虑2015年至2025年8月期间发表的英文文献,并纳入相关早期研究。还检索了参考文献列表以获取更多文章。数据综合:麻疹是人类最具有传染性的疾病之一。典型特征包括发热、咳嗽、流涕、结膜炎和麻疹样皮疹。严重的呼吸系统和神经系统并发症可能需要重症监护住院治疗。如脑炎等并发症可能在急性感染后数周至数年才出现。治疗仍以支持性为主,推荐补充维生素A。急性及重症护理护理的优先事项包括早期识别、隔离预防、样本采集、呼吸和血流动力学支持、神经系统监测、连续评估、补液、营养支持以及照顾者教育。结论:尽管麻疹是可预防的疾病,但其疫情在美国仍出现回升。护士的准备度,包括对临床特征、并发症和感染控制的知识,对于减少发病率和死亡率以及支持疫情预防至关重要。

papers.title: Importation-Driven Measles Resurgence and the Fragility of Elimination, Japan, 2024–2026
papers.abstract: As measles elimination unravels across the Americas, Europe, and the Western Pacific, Japan is experiencing a resurgence of measles; the World Health Organization had verified elimination of measles in Japan in 2015. By epidemiologic week 20 of 2026, a total of 498 cases had been reported, exceeding every full-year total since 2020. Median case-patient age has fallen to 26 years, shifting the burden from a generation who received single-dose measles vaccinations to younger cohorts caught between successive vaccination-policy transitions. Among case-patients with a documented 2-dose vaccination history, more than half experienced modified measles, an attenuated, easily missed illness that delays diagnosis and isolation. As mass gatherings concentrate global travel, Japan has become a sentinel for the fragility of measles elimination, including in countries that consider elimination status secure. Surveillance shows importation-driven resurgence; the shift in genotype profile from D8 to B3 predominance back to D8 enabled tracking of source countries.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于日本麻疹病毒的再流行,探讨了在世界卫生组织于2015年确认消除状态后,麻疹疾病重新出现的因素。核心问题是麻疹的再流行如何由输入驱动,以及这对全球麻疹消除工作的意义。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述报告了2024年至2026年间日本的麻疹病例,包括病例数量、年龄分布和基因型变化的数据。它包含对监测数据的元分析,并突出了从基因型D8占优转变为B3占优,再回到D8占优的变化,这有助于追踪输入病例的来源国。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,日本麻疹的再流行主要由输入驱动,基因型谱系的显著变化使得能够追踪输入病例的来源国。同时,它还指出,由于疫苗接种政策的变化,年轻群体现在更容易受到感染。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,在接种过疫苗的个体中,超过一半出现了修改型麻疹,这是一种减弱且容易被忽视的形式,会延迟诊断和隔离。这引发了对当前监测方法在检测和控制暴发方面的有效性的担忧。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议,日本作为麻疹消除脆弱性的哨兵,强调需要改进监测,特别是对修改型麻疹病例的检测,并保持高水平的疫苗接种接种覆盖率以防止未来的暴发。

papers.title: Measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccination under-recording in primary care in England: a two-stage cluster survey to inform vaccine optimisation
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Achieving 95% coverage for measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) is essential to controlling measles and achieving elimination status. Accurate coverage information is required to identify susceptible populations and inform public health action. This study aimed to estimate the extent of under-recording of MMR vaccinations in digitised primary care records, to inform vaccination optimisation activities. METHODS: We conducted a two-stage cluster survey of patients registered at GP practices, stratified by London and the rest of England, to determine MMR vaccination status and record type (electronically extractable or other) for all patients aged 1-29 years by age group. Firstly, practices extracted MMR vaccination information by electronic query of digital records for eligible patients, with data coded as unvaccinated, partially vaccinated, or fully vaccinated. Secondly, each practice updated the vaccination status for a random sample of 30 partially or unvaccinated patients (five in each age group) by manually searching all available practice records for any vaccinations given but not identified electronically. RESULTS: The GP practice response rate was 48% (279/576). MMR vaccinations were not consistently coded in primary care: among 2-to 4-year-olds with completed MMR vaccination in their primary care record (in any form), 18.3% in England and 11.4% in London appeared partially or unvaccinated by electronic query. This increased to 31.9% (England) and 23.5% (London) among 5- to 9-year-olds, and 31.1% (England) and 24.3% (London) among 10- to 16-year-olds. For all age groups other than 25-29 years, the proportion of patients with incomplete MMR vaccination was slightly higher in London than the rest of England. CONCLUSION: We identified inconsistent coding of MMR vaccinations in primary care records, which is likely to have contributed to underestimation of national coverage over time. However, immunisation gaps persisted even after accounting for inaccurate coding. Recording and coding should continue to be improved, together with addressing barriers to vaccination uptake.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the under-recording of measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccinations in primary care records in England. Using a two-stage cluster survey, the researchers assessed the accuracy of electronic coding of vaccination status across different age groups. They found that MMR vaccinations were inconsistently recorded, leading to potential underestimation of coverage. Despite accounting for coding errors, immunisation gaps remained, suggesting the need for improved data recording and addressing barriers to vaccination. The findings underscore the importance of refining data systems to support effective vaccine optimisation and public health action.

papers.abstract_zh: INTRODUCTION: 实现95%的麻疹、麻疹和风疹(MMR)接种覆盖率对于控制麻疹并实现消除状态至关重要。准确的覆盖率信息对于识别易感人群并指导公共卫生行动是必要的。本研究旨在估计数字化初级医疗记录中MMR 疫苗接种的低估程度,以促进疫苗接种优化活动。METHODS: 我们对在GP诊所注册的患者进行了两阶段集群调查,按伦敦和英格兰其他地区分层,以确定所有1-29岁患者按年龄组的MMR 疫苗接种状态和记录类型(可电子提取或其它)。首先,诊所通过电子查询数字记录获取符合条件患者的MMR 疫苗接种信息,数据编码为未接种、部分接种或完全接种。其次,每个诊所通过手动搜索所有可用的诊所记录,对随机选取的30名部分或未接种的患者(每个年龄组5人)更新其疫苗接种状态,以确认是否曾接种但未被电子识别。RESULTS: GP诊所的响应率为48%(279/576)。在初级医疗记录中,MMR 疫苗接种的编码不一致:在2-4岁且其记录中已完成MMR 疫苗接种的儿童中,英格兰有18.3%、伦敦有11.4%的儿童通过电子查询显示为部分或未接种。在5-9岁儿童中,这一比例上升至英格兰31.9%、伦敦23.5%;在10-16岁儿童中,比例为英格兰31.1%、伦敦24.3%。对于所有年龄组(除25-29岁外),伦敦的MMR 疫苗接种不完整比例略高于英格兰其他地区。CONCLUSION: 我们发现初级医疗记录中MMR 疫苗接种的编码不一致,这可能导致了国家接种覆盖率的低估。然而,即使考虑了不准确的编码,疫苗接种缺口仍然存在,表明需要继续改进记录和编码实践。

papers.title: Timeliness of measles vaccination in selected districts of Oromia Region, Ethiopia – 2021
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Delays in vaccination with the first/second dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1, MCV2) increases risk of measles transmission. MCV2 was added to Ethiopia's routine immunization schedule in 2019, administered at age 15 months. We describe age at measles vaccination and characteristics associated with timely vaccination following MCV2 introduction. METHODS: A secondary analysis from a 2021 cross-sectional household survey of children aged 12-35 months in Oromia, Ethiopia was conducted. MCV vaccination status and age at vaccination were determined from the child's vaccination card. The cumulative card-confirmed vaccination coverage of MCV1 and MCV2 (among children 24-35 months) by age at vaccination was estimated. Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination were analyzed using multivariate logistic regression, with urban/rural stratification. RESULTS: Overall, 651 children aged 12-35 months (MCV1) and a subset of 270 children aged 24-35 months (MCV2) were analyzed. Cumulative MCV1 coverage was 59.9% by age 9 months and 76.3% by age 12 months, and MCV2 was 33.0% by age 15 months and 44.8% by age 24 months. MCV coverage was generally higher in urban compared to rural areas. Among vaccinated children, the proportion receiving early, timely, and delayed doses was 30.1%, 44.5%, and 25.3% for MCV1, and 28.6%, 41.2%, and 30.3% for MCV2, respectively. Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination differed in urban and rural areas, but common themes included increased caregiver immunization awareness and service delivery aspects. CONCLUSIONS: Although most children who received MCV1 were vaccinated by 12 months, many received delayed doses. MCV2 coverage was low, irrespective of vaccination timing. Findings highlight the importance of routine catch-up vaccination policies and guidance, and the need for tailored strategies in urban and rural settings to improve MCV coverage and timely vaccination.

papers.title_zh: 麻疹 疫苗接种 在埃塞俄比亚奥罗米亚地区选定地区的及时性 – 2021
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Delays in vaccination with the first/second dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1, MCV2) increases risk of measles transmission. MCV2 was added to Ethiopia's routine immunization schedule in 2019, administered at age 15 months. We describe age at measles vaccination and characteristics associated with timely vaccination following MCV2 introduction. METHODS: A secondary analysis from a 2021 cross-sectional household survey of children aged 12-35 months in Oromia, Ethiopia was conducted. MCV vaccination status and age at vaccination were determined from the child's vaccination card. The cumulative card-confirmed vaccination coverage of MCV1 and MCV2 (among children 24-35 months) by age at vaccination was estimated. Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination were analyzed using multivariate logistic regression, with urban/rural stratification. RESULTS: Overall, 651 children aged 12-35 months (MCV1) and a subset of 270 children aged 24-35 months (MCV2) were analyzed. Cumulative MCV1 coverage was 59.9% by age 9 months and 76.3% by age 12 months, and MCV2 was 33.0% by age 15 months and 44.8% by age 24 months. MCV coverage was generally higher in urban compared to rural areas. Among vaccinated children, the proportion receiving early, timely, and delayed doses was 30.1%, 44.5%, and 25.3% for MCV1, and 28.6%, 41.2%, and 30.3% for MCV2, respectively. Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination differed in urban and rural areas, but common themes included increased caregiver immunization awareness and service delivery aspects. CONCLUSIONS: Although most children who received MCV1 were vaccinated by 12 months, many received delayed doses. MCV2 coverage was low, irrespective of vaccination timing. Findings highlight the importance of routine catch-up vaccination policies and guidance, and the need for tailored strategies in urban and rural settings to improve MCV coverage and timely vaccination.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:在接种含疫苗(MCV1、MCV2)的麻疹疫苗的第一/第二剂时出现延迟会增加传播的风险。MCV2于2019年被纳入埃塞俄比亚的常规免疫计划,接种年龄为15个月。我们描述了在MCV2引入后,儿童接种疫苗接种的年龄及其与及时接种相关的特征。方法:对埃塞俄比亚奥罗米亚州2021年一项针对12-35个月儿童的横断面家庭调查进行了二次分析。MCV 疫苗接种接种状态和接种年龄是从儿童的疫苗接种卡中确定的。估计了24-35个月儿童中MCV1和MCV2的累计卡确认接种覆盖率,按接种年龄进行分析。使用多变量逻辑回归分析了与及时MCV1接种相关的特征,并按城乡进行分层。结果:总体分析了651名12-35个月的儿童(MCV1)和其中270名24-35个月的儿童(MCV2)。MCV1的累计接种覆盖率为9个月时59.9%,12个月时76.3%;MCV2的累计接种覆盖率为15个月时33.0%,24个月时44.8%。MCV接种覆盖率在城市地区普遍高于农村地区。在接种过疫苗的儿童中,早期、及时和延迟接种的比例分别为MCV1的30.1%、44.5%和25.3%,以及MCV2的28.6%、41.2%和30.3%。与及时MCV1接种相关的特征在城乡地区有所不同,但共同主题包括增加的照顾者疫苗接种意识和服务提供方面。结论:尽管大多数接种MCV1的儿童在12个月内完成了接种,但许多儿童接种时间有所延迟。无论接种时间如何,MCV2的接种覆盖率都较低。这些发现强调了常规补种政策和指导的重要性,并突出了在城乡地区制定针对性策略以提高MCV接种覆盖率和及时接种的必要性。

papers.title: Somalia is battling concurrent outbreaks of cholera, measles, and diphtheria driven by severe drought and displacement
papers.abstract: Somalia is experiencing concurrent cholera, measles, and diphtheria outbreaks driven by climate change, conflict, displacement, malnutrition, inadequate water and sanitation, and fragile health systems. This letter argues that these overlapping epidemics should be recognized as a syndemic rather than independent outbreaks because they share common structural determinants that amplify transmission and mortality. We advocate for integrated surveillance, combined vaccination strategies, strengthened laboratory capacity, nutrition support, climate-informed early warning systems, resilient primary healthcare, and sustained financing to improve outbreak preparedness and response in Somalia and similar fragile settings.

papers.title: Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation for life-threatening measles in children: a case series
papers.abstract: Abstract Measles is resurgent worldwide, and although vaccine-preventable, severe disease can progress to cardiorespiratory failure refractory to conventional support. This study aimed to determine whether extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) is feasible in children with measles. A retrospective case series at a tertiary pediatric intensive care unit (PICU) with a regional ECMO program, of all children younger than 18 years with laboratory-confirmed measles who received ECMO during the August 2025–May 2026 outbreak. Of 49 children with measles admitted to the PICU, 10 received ECMO. Five were male; median age was 11 months (IQR, 10–24), and none had completed age-appropriate vaccination. Indications were septic shock or cardiorespiratory failure ( n = 5), acute respiratory distress syndrome with septic shock ( n = 2), hypoxemic respiratory failure ( n = 2), and suspected myocarditis ( n = 1). Seven received venoarterial, 1 veno-venoarterial, and 2 venovenous ECMO. Bacteremia preceded ECMO in 5 children and positive sputum culture in 8. Candida tropicalis candidemia developed in 3 of the first 5 patients, with none among the subsequent 5 after antifungal prophylaxis at cannulation. Left ventricular dysfunction was present in 7 of 9 assessed, 4 required decompression, and neuroimaging was abnormal in 4 of 8 imaged. Six children (60%) survived to discharge. Conclusions : ECMO was feasible and potentially lifesaving in measles-associated cardiorespiratory failure, with survival comparable to other high-acuity pediatric indications, but the course was complicated by bacterial and fungal coinfection, cardiac dysfunction, and neurologic injury. These resource-intensive presentations occurred exclusively in unvaccinated children and were preventable, underscoring measles vaccination coverage as a public health priority. What is Known: • Measles is resurgent worldwide and can cause severe respiratory, cardiac, and immune complications in children. • Measles-induced immune suppression predisposes to secondary bacterial and fungal infection. What is New: • First reported series of ECMO for measles: feasible, with 60% survival, but marked by coinfection, cardiac dysfunction, and neurologic injury. • Antifungal prophylaxis at ECMO cannulation was associated with elimination of candidemia in this cohort.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports on the use of extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) in 10 unvaccinated children with severe measles during an outbreak. The research aimed to assess the feasibility of ECMO in measles-associated cardiorespiratory failure. The evidence suggests that ECMO is a viable treatment option for life-threatening measles cases, though further research is needed to confirm these results in larger populations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹在全球范围内再次流行,尽管疫苗可预防,但严重病例可进展为对常规支持无反应的心肺衰竭。本研究旨在确定体外膜肺氧合(ECMO)是否适用于麻疹患儿。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究为回顾性病例系列,研究对象为一家三级儿科重症监护病房(PICU)中所有在2025年8月至2026年5月暴发期间接受ECMO治疗的、年龄小于18岁的实验室确诊麻疹患儿。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究纳入了所有在2025年8月至2026年5月暴发期间接受ECMO治疗的、年龄小于18岁且实验室确诊麻疹的患儿。ECMO的适应症包括败血性休克或心肺衰竭、伴有败血性休克的急性呼吸窘迫综合征、低氧性呼吸衰竭以及疑似心肌炎。
elements_zh.main_results: Of 49 children with measles admitted to the PICU, 10 received ECMO. Seven received venoarterial, 1 veno-venoarterial, and 2 venovenous ECMO. Bacteremia preceded ECMO in 5 children and positive sputum culture in 8. Candida tropicalis candidemia developed in 3 of the first 5 patients, with none among the subsequent 5 after antifungal prophylaxis at cannulation.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在麻疹相关的心肺衰竭中,ECMO是可行的,并可能挽救生命,其生存率与其他高危儿科适应症相当。在ECMO导管插入时使用抗真菌预防措施与本队列研究中念珠菌血症的消除相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些资源密集型的临床表现仅出现在未接种疫苗的儿童中,并且是可预防的,这突显了麻疹 疫苗接种接种覆盖率作为公共卫生优先事项的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其回顾性设计和小样本量,但研究结果得到了对麻疹患者使用ECMO的直接观察和结果的支持。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 麻疹在全球范围内再次流行,尽管疫苗可预防,但严重病例可进展为对常规支持无反应的心肺衰竭。本研究旨在确定体外膜肺氧合(ECMO)是否适用于麻疹患儿。本研究为回顾性病例系列,研究对象为一家三级儿科重症监护病房(PICU)中所有在2025年8月至2026年5月暴发期间接受ECMO治疗的、年龄小于18岁的实验室确诊麻疹患儿。共有49名麻疹患儿被收治入PICU,其中10名接受了ECMO治疗。5名为男性;中位年龄为11个月(IQR,10–24),且无一例完成年龄合适的疫苗接种。ECMO的适应症包括败血性休克或心肺衰竭(n=5)、伴有败血性休克的急性呼吸窘迫综合征(n=2)、低氧性呼吸衰竭(n=2)以及疑似心肌炎(n=1)。7名患儿接受了静脉动脉ECMO,1名接受了静脉-静脉动脉ECMO,2名接受了静脉静脉ECMO。5名患儿在ECMO前存在菌血症,8名存在阳性痰培养。前5名患者中有3例发展为热带念珠菌血症,而在接受导管插入时使用抗真菌预防措施后,后续5名患者中未出现念珠菌血症。9名评估的患儿中有7名存在左心室功能障碍,其中4名需要减压,8名接受影像学检查的患儿中有4名出现异常影像。6名患儿(60%)存活至出院。结论:在麻疹相关的心肺衰竭中,ECMO是可行的,并可能挽救生命,其生存率与其他高危儿科适应症相当,但病情复杂,伴有细菌和真菌合并感染、心脏功能障碍和神经系统损伤。这些资源密集型的临床表现仅出现在未接种疫苗的儿童中,并且是可预防的,这突显了麻疹 疫苗接种接种覆盖率作为公共卫生优先事项的重要性。已知信息:• 麻疹在全球范围内再次流行,可导致儿童严重的呼吸、心脏和免疫并发症。• 麻疹引发的免疫抑制使患儿易发生继发性细菌和真菌感染。新发现:• 首次报道的麻疹患儿ECMO治疗系列:ECMO是可行的,生存率为60%,但伴有合并感染、心脏功能障碍和神经系统损伤。• 在ECMO导管插入时使用抗真菌预防措施与本队列研究中念珠菌血症的消除相关。

papers.title: Projected effects of removing school-entry vaccination requirements on measles transmission in Florida
papers.abstract: Florida's proposal to remove vaccine mandates in the state raises urgent questions about the state's vulnerability to measles resurgence. We develop and analyze an age-structured measles transmission model with heterogeneous contact patterns between children and adults, calibrated using data from the 2025 measles outbreak in Gaines County, Texas, and applied to Florida using state-specific demographic structure and measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination coverage. Using Florida-specific mixing patterns and demographic composition, we estimate the state's vaccine-induced herd immunity threshold and find that current MMR coverage already falls below the level required to prevent sustained measles transmission. Sensitivity analyses highlight that small reductions in child vaccination rates yield disproportionately large increases in outbreak magnitude, especially under strong assortative mixing among children. These findings indicate that Florida's vaccination policies are approaching a critical tipping point: Maintaining or improving MMR vaccination coverage is essential to prevent measles from reestablishing endemic circulation within the state and potentially spreading to the broader United States.

papers.abstract_zh: 佛罗里达州提出取消该州疫苗强制要求的提案引发了关于该州对麻疹再次暴发的脆弱性的紧迫问题。我们开发并分析了一个基于年龄的麻疹 传播模型,该模型考虑了儿童与成人之间异质性的接触模式,并利用来自德克萨斯州加内斯县2025年麻疹 暴发的数据进行校准,同时结合佛罗里达州特定的人口结构和麻疹-麻疹-风疹(MMR)疫苗接种覆盖率应用于该州。通过使用佛罗里达州特定的接触模式和人口构成,我们估计了该州由疫苗引发的群体免疫阈值,并发现当前的MMR覆盖率已低于防止麻疹持续传播所需的水平。模拟显示,在取消入学要求后,MMR 疫苗接种覆盖率的下降进一步增加了暴发的传播潜力,导致自疫苗普及前时代以来未见的疫情规模,并预计未来五年内将出现大量儿童死亡。敏感性分析表明,儿童疫苗接种率的微小下降会导致暴发规模的显著增加,尤其是在儿童之间强 assortative mixing 的情况下。这些发现表明,佛罗里达州的疫苗接种政策正接近一个关键的临界点:保持或提高MMR 疫苗接种覆盖率对于防止麻疹在该州重新建立地方性流行,并可能扩散到整个美国至关重要。

papers.title: The Impermanence of Public Health Gains—Lessons Learned from Measles Resurgence, Bangladesh, 2026
papers.abstract: The global resurgence of measles is a major public health concern. After the success of its Expanded Programme on Immunization, Bangladesh experienced a measles resurgence in 2026. The country faced major setbacks after measles vaccination coverage declined because of political instability, discontent among field-level staff, change in procurement policy, COVID-19-related service disruptions, and delayed supplementary immunization campaigns. During March 15-September 13, 2026, Bangladesh reported 170,638 suspected and 20,006 confirmed measles cases, including 919 deaths among suspected and 100 deaths among laboratory-confirmed cases. The outbreak disproportionately affected unvaccinated and underimmunized children. Political turmoil during 2024-2025 disrupted vaccine procurement, delayed mass vaccination campaigns, weakened the health workforce, and compromised financial and logistic continuity. Simultaneously, disruptions in vitamin A supplementation and worsening child malnutrition amplified disease severity. To prevent future resurgence, immunization programs must be depoliticized, supported by buffer vaccine stocks, strengthened through microlevel surveillance, and integrated with nutrition and primary healthcare services.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the resurgence of measles in Bangladesh in 2026, focusing on the factors contributing to the decline in vaccination coverage and the resulting public health impact. The central question is how measles resurgence occurred despite prior immunization success and what lessons can be learned for future prevention.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative analysis of the measles resurgence in Bangladesh, drawing on reports from the Expanded Programme on Immunization and public health records. It does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or systematic review methods, but it provides a detailed account of the outbreak and its contributing factors.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that the measles resurgence in Bangladesh was primarily due to a decline in vaccination coverage caused by political instability, disruptions in vaccine procurement, and delayed supplementary immunization campaigns. It also highlights the impact of child malnutrition and vitamin A supplementation disruptions on disease severity.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that the resurgence was not fully anticipated, and there are gaps in understanding the precise mechanisms linking political instability and vaccine coverage decline. Additionally, the role of other factors such as community engagement and health system resilience is not thoroughly explored.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future measles prevention efforts should focus on depoliticizing immunization programs, maintaining buffer vaccine stocks, strengthening microlevel surveillance, and integrating measles control with nutrition and primary healthcare services.

analysis.summary_en: This review analyzes the measles resurgence in Bangladesh in 2026, highlighting the decline in vaccination coverage due to political instability, disruptions in vaccine procurement, and delayed campaigns. It notes the impact of child malnutrition and vitamin A supplementation on disease severity and emphasizes the need for depoliticized immunization programs, buffer stocks, and integrated healthcare strategies to prevent future outbreaks. The review underscores the importance of strengthening surveillance and addressing systemic vulnerabilities to ensure sustained public health gains.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对孟加拉国麻疹疫情反弹的叙述性分析,依据扩大免疫规划报告和公共卫生记录。它并未明确报告元分析或系统综述的方法,但提供了关于暴发及其相关因素的详细描述。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,孟加拉国麻疹疫情反弹的主要原因是疫苗接种疫苗接种覆盖率下降,这归因于政治动荡、疫苗疫苗采购中断以及补充免疫活动的延迟。此外,还强调了儿童营养状况恶化和维生素A补充计划中断对疾病严重程度的影响。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,此次疫情反弹并未被完全预见,且在理解政治动荡与疫苗疫苗接种覆盖率下降之间的具体机制方面仍存在知识空白。此外,社区参与和卫生系统韧性等其他因素的作用尚未被深入探讨。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议,未来的麻疹预防工作应着重于去政治化免疫规划,维持缓冲的疫苗疫苗库存,加强微观层面的监测活动,并将麻疹控制与营养和初级卫生保健服务整合。

papers.title: Whole-Genome Sequencing of Measles Virus from 2025 Outbreak, Texas, USA
papers.abstract: We sequenced measles-positive samples from the 2025 outbreak in Texas, USA, and identified the expansion of a closely related genotype D8 lineage within broader strain diversity from North America. F:H419R was used as a lineage-associated genomic surveillance marker. Our findings demonstrate that whole-genome sequencing can strengthen measles surveillance and enhance outbreak investigations.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the genetic diversity of measles virus during the 2025 outbreak in Texas, USA, and assess the role of genotype D8 in the broader strain context.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Whole-genome sequencing was performed on measles-positive samples collected during the 2025 outbreak in Texas, USA, to analyze the genetic characteristics of the virus within the outbreak setting.
analysis.methods: The researchers sequenced measles-positive samples and identified the expansion of a closely related genotype D8 lineage within the broader strain diversity observed in North America.
analysis.main_results: The study identified the expansion of genotype D8 within the broader strain diversity of measles virus in North America during the 2025 outbreak in Texas, USA.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that whole-genome sequencing can enhance measles surveillance and provide insights into outbreak investigations by identifying lineage-specific genetic markers.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform improved genomic surveillance strategies for measles virus and aid in understanding the epidemiology of outbreaks in North America.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to the 2025 outbreak in Texas, USA, and does not provide broader regional or global context, but the evidence is strong due to the direct sequencing of measles-positive samples.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the genetic diversity of measles virus during the 2025 outbreak in Texas, USA, using whole-genome sequencing. The researchers identified the expansion of a closely related genotype D8 lineage within the broader strain diversity observed in North America. Their findings highlight the potential of genomic sequencing to strengthen measles surveillance and improve outbreak investigations. The study contributes to understanding the genetic dynamics of measles virus in specific outbreaks and has implications for public health strategies. However, the evidence is limited to the Texas outbreak and does not provide broader regional or global context, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The study's methods and results are robust, offering a moderate level of confidence in the conclusions drawn.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,全基因组基因组测序可以增强麻疹的监测,并通过识别谱系特异性遗传标记,为暴发的研究提供见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以为改进基因组监测策略提供信息,并有助于理解北美暴发的流行病学。

papers.title: Wastewater Surveillance to Track Resurgent Measles Outbreak, Ontario, Canada, 2025
papers.abstract: The province of Ontario, Canada, experienced a major resurgent outbreak of measles in 2025. We conducted wastewater surveillance concurrently with clinical-based surveillance to track measles incidence in southwestern Ontario, adjacent to the United States. Measles virus (MeV) signal in wastewater was positively associated with clinical cases but did not provide early alert of changes in measles incidence when resolved by epidemiologic week. Assessment of virus partitioning showed MeV RNA was broadly distributed in the liquid phase but is most concentrated in the solids. We adapted an assay for differentiation of vaccine and wild-type MeV and used it to detect vaccine genotype measles after a vaccination campaign targeting underserved groups. We estimated MeV shedding in wastewater through sampling of sewer laterals serving a hospital treating measles infections. This outbreak is a case study in which we highlighted the use of wastewater surveillance for measles while supporting method development in real time.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Ontario, Canada, experienced a major resurgent outbreak of measles in 2025. The study aimed to evaluate the utility of wastewater surveillance in tracking measles incidence.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Wastewater surveillance was conducted concurrently with clinical-based surveillance in southwestern Ontario, near the United States, to monitor measles incidence during the outbreak.
analysis.methods: Wastewater surveillance was adapted to differentiate vaccine and wild-type measles virus, and samples were collected from sewer laterals serving a hospital treating measles infections.
analysis.main_results: MeV RNA was broadly distributed in the liquid phase but most concentrated in the solids. The measles virus signal in wastewater was positively associated with clinical cases but did not provide early alert of changes in measles incidence when resolved by epidemiologic week.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated that wastewater surveillance can be used to track measles virus activity, although it may not be effective for early detection of incidence changes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the use of wastewater surveillance as a tool for measles monitoring and highlight the importance of method development for real-time tracking of viral outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited to a specific geographic area and did not provide early alerts for incidence changes, suggesting that further research is needed to validate its broader applicability.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the use of wastewater surveillance to track a resurgent measles outbreak in Ontario, Canada, in 2025. The researchers conducted wastewater and clinical-based surveillance in southwestern Ontario to monitor measles incidence. They adapted an assay to differentiate between vaccine and wild-type measles virus and collected samples from sewer laterals serving a hospital treating measles infections. The results showed that MeV RNA was broadly distributed in the liquid phase but most concentrated in the solids. The measles virus signal in wastewater was positively associated with clinical cases but did not provide early alerts for changes in incidence when resolved by epidemiologic week. The study interpreted these findings as demonstrating the potential of wastewater surveillance for measles monitoring, although it may not be effective for early detection of incidence changes. The results have implications for improving surveillance methods and real-time tracking of viral outbreaks. However, the study was limited to a specific geographic area and did not provide early alerts for incidence changes, indicating the need for further research to validate its broader applicability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 加拿大安大略省在2025年经历了一次严重的麻疹病毒暴发。本研究旨在评估污水监测在追踪麻疹病毒传播中的作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在西南安大略省,靠近美国地区,污水监测与基于临床的监测同时进行,以监测麻疹病毒传播情况。
elements_zh.methods: 污水监测被调整以区分麻疹病毒变异株和野生型麻疹病毒,样本从服务于治疗麻疹病毒感染医院的污水管道中采集。
elements_zh.main_results: MeV RNA在液相中广泛分布,但在固体中最为集中。污水中的麻疹病毒信号与临床病例呈正相关,但在按流行病学周划分时未能提供麻疹病毒传播变化的早期预警。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Ontario, Canada, experienced a major resurgent outbreak of measles in 2025. The study aimed to evaluate the utility of wastewater surveillance in tracking measles incidence.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: Wastewater surveillance was conducted concurrently with clinical-based surveillance in southwestern Ontario, near the United States, to monitor measles incidence during the outbreak.
analysis_en.methods: Wastewater surveillance was adapted to differentiate vaccine and wild-type measles virus, and samples were collected from sewer laterals serving a hospital treating measles infections.
analysis_en.main_results: MeV RNA was broadly distributed in the liquid phase but most concentrated in the solids. The measles virus signal in wastewater was positively associated with clinical cases but did not provide early alert of changes in measles incidence when resolved by epidemiologic week.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated that wastewater surveillance can be used to track measles virus activity, although it may not be effective for early detection of incidence changes.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the use of wastewater surveillance as a tool for measles monitoring and highlight the importance of method development for real-time tracking of viral outbreaks.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited to a specific geographic area and did not provide early alerts for incidence changes, suggesting that further research is needed to validate its broader applicability.

papers.title_zh: 废水监测用于追踪加拿大安大略省西南部2025年回升的麻疹病毒暴发
papers.source_body_en: The province of Ontario, Canada, experienced a major resurgent outbreak of measles in 2025. We conducted wastewater surveillance concurrently with clinical-based surveillance to track measles incidence in southwestern Ontario, adjacent to the United States. Measles virus (MeV) signal in wastewater was positively associated with clinical cases but did not provide early alert of changes in measles incidence when resolved by epidemiologic week. Assessment of virus partitioning showed MeV RNA was broadly distributed in the liquid phase but is most concentrated in the solids. We adapted an assay for differentiation of vaccine and wild-type MeV and used it to detect vaccine genotype measles after a vaccination campaign targeting underserved groups. We estimated MeV shedding in wastewater through sampling of sewer laterals serving a hospital treating measles infections. This outbreak is a case study in which we highlighted the use of wastewater surveillance for measles while supporting method development in real time.

papers.title: Measles Whole Genome Sequencing by an Illumina Tiled Amplification Method.
papers.abstract: Measles virus remains a significant global health threat, and despite the availability of an effective vaccine, measles cases continue to increase worldwide in recent years. Genomic surveillance has become an essential tool for monitoring virus circulation and investigating outbreaks. Here, we describe a wet laboratory method for whole‐genome sequencing of measles virus using a tiled amplicon approach and Illumina sequencing technology. A previously published Oxford Nanopore based tiled primer scheme was adapted to include both circulating measles genotypes and for use on the Illumina platform. Two Illumina library preparation kits, Illumina DNA Prep (IDP) and Nextera XT (XT), were evaluated for performance. The IDP kit demonstrated more complete genomes and consistent genome coverage compared with XT. Using quantified reference genomes, the limit of detection was determined to be 10,000 genome copies for genotype B3 and D8. Sequence accuracy was evaluated using previously characterized clinical samples and showed high concordance. This method provides a reliable and sensitive approach for measles virus whole genome sequencing using Illumina platforms and is suitable for genomic surveillance applications.

A previously published Oxford Nanopore based tiled primer scheme was adapted to include both circulating measles genotypes and for use on the Illumina platform. Two Illumina library preparation kits, Illumina DNA Prep (IDP) and Nextera XT (XT), were evaluated for performance. The IDP kit demonstrated more complete genomes and consistent genome coverage compared with XT. Using quantified reference genomes, the limit of detection was determined to be 10,000 genome copies for genotype B3 and D8. Sequence accuracy was evaluated using previously characterized clinical samples and showed high concordance. This method provides a reliable and sensitive approach for measles virus whole genome sequencing using Illumina platforms and is suitable for genomic surveillance applications.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the impact of measles outbreaks on pediatric mortality in Jerusalem, Israel, during 2025–2026, highlighting the need to understand measles-specific mortality rates in vulnerable populations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective study was conducted in Jerusalem, Israel, during April 2025 to March 2026, examining 1,289 measles case-patients, including 11 pediatric deaths across the city's population.
analysis.methods: The study analyzed measles case-patients and deaths reported during the outbreak period, focusing on mortality rates and attributing deaths to measles based on epidemiological data and population-specific trends.
analysis.main_results: Of 1,289 measles case-patients, 11 children died, resulting in a measles-specific mortality rate of 1.1 deaths/100,000 population. In 6 ultraorthodox Jewish neighborhoods, the measles-specific mortality rate among children <5 years of age was 80.1 deaths/100,000 population.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate a significantly higher measles-attributed death fraction in ultraorthodox Jewish neighborhoods, underscoring disparities in measles mortality among different demographic groups.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the importance of targeted measles surveillance and vaccination efforts in high-risk communities to reduce pediatric mortality rates.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to reported case-patients and deaths, and the measles-attributed death fraction is based on epidemiological trends rather than definitive pathogen confirmation, resulting in moderate confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed measles-related pediatric deaths during an outbreak in Jerusalem, Israel, from April 2025 to March 2026. It found that 11 children died, yielding a measles-specific mortality rate of 1.1 deaths per 100,000 population. In six ultraorthodox Jewish neighborhoods, the mortality rate among children under five was 80.1 deaths per 100,000 population, with a 47% measles-attributed death fraction. These results emphasize the heightened risk of measles mortality in certain communities, underscoring the need for targeted public health interventions. The study's reliance on reported cases and epidemiological trends rather than direct pathogen confirmation limits its evidence strength, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

papers.title: Estimating age-stratified measles susceptibility using the screening method: an example from 2018–21 measles resurgence in Brazil
papers.abstract: Abstract Objectives Characterizing susceptibility profiles across age groups and administrative units is essential for targeted vaccination and control of resurgent vaccine-preventable diseases like measles, but is often limited by the lack of historical vaccination records. Methods We proposed a methodology based on the screening method that uses routine surveillance data, such as case age and vaccination status, along with an estimate of vaccine effectiveness, to estimate age-stratified susceptibility to a vaccine-preventable disease. Results Applying this method to the 10 most affected Brazilian municipalities by measles resurgence in 2018–21, we signal municipalities that have a population immunity below the herd immunity threshold, along with the age groups with the largest susceptible cohorts. Some municipalities show an overall large susceptibility, while others concentrate susceptible individuals in the age cohorts >20 years, as a result of past low vaccine coverage. Conclusion The proposed methodology is a low-cost tool to estimate susceptibility using readily available surveillance data, allowing for identification of susceptible age cohorts, even in the absence of historical vaccination data. The results obtained offer actionable insights for designing vaccination strategies in Brazil as well as similar epidemiological contexts, as the methodology can be easily applied on similar datasets.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 了解不同年龄组和行政单位的易感性特征对于有针对性地进行疫苗接种和控制重新出现的疫苗可预防疾病的传播至关重要,但往往受到缺乏历史疫苗接种记录的限制。方法 我们提出了一种基于筛查法的方法,利用常规的监测数据,如病例年龄和疫苗接种状态,以及对疫苗有效性的估计,来估算对疫苗可预防疾病的年龄分层易感性。结果 将该方法应用于2018–21年巴西受麻疹疫情反弹影响最严重的10个市镇,我们识别出那些群体免疫水平低于群体免疫阈值的市镇,以及易感性最高的年龄组。一些市镇表现出总体较高的易感性,而另一些市镇则在年龄队列研究 >20岁的人群中集中了易感个体,这是由于过去疫苗覆盖率较低所致。结论 所提出的这种方法是一种低成本工具,可以利用现成的监测数据估算易感性,即使在缺乏历史疫苗接种数据的情况下,也能识别出易感年龄组。所获得的结果为设计巴西及类似流行病学背景下的疫苗接种策略提供了可操作的见解,因为该方法可以轻松应用于类似的数据集。

papers.title: Genomic Epidemiology of Measles Viruses Circulating During the 2026 Nationwide Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh.
papers.abstract: Bangladesh experienced a large-scale resurgence of measles during 2026. We investigated the genomic epidemiology of the measles virus (MeV) during this outbreak. A total of 100 suspected cases were recruited from a tertiary care hospital in Dhaka, of whom 89 tested positive for MeV by RT-PCR. Near-complete MeV genomes were recovered from 24 selected samples. Phylogenetic analysis showed that the outbreak was associated with closely related MeV sequences belonging to genotype B3. The median age of the confirmed cases was 8 months, with 61% cases younger than 9 months. Among the confirmed cases, 79% were unvaccinated.
papers.journal: International journal of infectious diseases : IJID : official publication of the International Society for Infectious Diseases

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the genomic epidemiology of measles virus during the 2026 nationwide outbreak in Bangladesh. A total of 100 suspected cases were recruited, with 89 testing positive for MeV by RT-PCR. Near-complete genomes were recovered from 24 samples, and phylogenetic analysis revealed that the outbreak was linked to genotype B3 sequences. The median age of confirmed cases was 8 months, with 61% under 9 months. Among these, 79% were unvaccinated. The study provides insights into the circulating genotype, which can aid in surveillance and control efforts. However, the findings are limited by the study's focus on a single hospital and its moderate evidence strength due to the relatively small sample size and geographic scope.

papers.title: Operational drivers of measles outbreaks in Uganda: a multi-district outbreak causality analysis, July 2025– March 2026
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Measles outbreaks in Uganda persist despite the availability of an effective vaccine, suggesting persistent immunity gaps and health system weaknesses. We conducted a multi-district outbreak causality analysis (OCA) to identify programmatic and health-system contributors to measles outbreaks and inform measles elimination programming. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional mixed-methods OCA across 12 affected districts in Uganda (2025–2026), guided by the World Health Organization framework. We reviewed measles case investigation reports and triangulated findings with qualitative interviews with district health teams, health workers, surveillance and immunisation staff, community leaders, Village Health Teams, and caregivers. We deductively analysed data to identify causal pathways and contributing factors. Findings were organized into four prespecified analytical themes: immunization service delivery, caregiver access and demand, surveillance and case detection, and outbreak preparedness and response. Results The 12 districts reported 1,302 cases, including 80 laboratory-confirmed cases and 10 suspected deaths (case-fatality rate: 0.77%); 46.5% (n = 606) occurred among children aged 18–59 months. Most cases (65.3%) occurred in unvaccinated children, versus 1.0% in children with both measles-rubella (MR) doses. Across districts, incomplete MR2 implementation, irregular outreach, inconsistent fixed-site vaccination, weak follow-up of children who missed vaccination, and transport and distance barriers contributed to persistent immunity gaps. Low clinical suspicion, limited engagement of Village Health Teams, laboratory and surveillance-information bottlenecks, absence of pre-positioned response plans, delayed response activation, and inadequate isolation capacity further limited early detection and control. Conclusion Measles outbreaks were driven primarily by missed vaccination, especially incomplete delivery of the two-dose MR schedule, compounded by access barriers, delayed case detection, and limited outbreak preparedness. Strengthening routine MR1 and MR2 delivery, targeted catch-up vaccination, community-linked surveillance, and pre-positioned district response plans with clear activation triggers will be critical to closing immunity gaps and accelerating measles elimination in Uganda.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 尽管在乌干达已有有效的抗病毒药物,但麻疹病毒仍持续流行,这表明免疫缺口和卫生系统薄弱问题依然存在。我们开展了一项多地区麻疹病毒因果分析(OCA),以识别影响麻疹病毒传播的计划和卫生系统因素,并为麻疹病毒消除计划提供依据。方法 我们根据世界卫生组织框架,在乌干达12个受影响地区进行了横断面混合方法的因果分析(OCA),时间范围为2025–2026年。我们审查了麻疹病例调查报告,并通过与地区卫生团队、卫生工作者、麻疹疫苗接种和免疫接种人员、社区领袖、村卫生队以及照顾者进行定性访谈来验证发现。我们采用演绎法分析数据,以确定因果路径和相关因素。研究结果被组织为四个预设的分析主题:疫苗接种服务的提供、照顾者获取和需求、麻疹病例的发现以及麻疹疫情的准备和响应。结果 12个地区报告了1,302例病例,包括80例实验室确诊病例和10例疑似死亡病例(病死率:0.77%);其中46.5%(n=606)发生在18至59个月龄的儿童中。大多数病例(65.3%)发生在未接种疫苗的儿童中,而接种了两剂麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹(MR)疫苗的儿童病例仅占1.0%。在各地区,MR2疫苗接种计划实施不完整、疫苗接种宣传不规律、固定接种点设置不一致、对未接种疫苗儿童的跟进不足,以及交通和距离障碍等因素,导致了持续的免疫缺口。临床怀疑程度低、村卫生队参与有限、实验室和病例信息瓶颈、缺乏预先部署的应急响应计划、响应启动延迟以及隔离能力不足进一步限制了早期病例发现和控制。结论 麻疹病毒的持续传播主要由疫苗接种漏种引起,尤其是两剂MR疫苗接种计划的不完整实施,同时受到获取障碍、病例发现延迟和应急响应准备不足的叠加影响。加强常规MR1和MR2疫苗接种、有针对性的补种活动、与社区联系的病例监测,以及预先部署的地区应急响应计划并明确启动触发条件,将是缩小免疫缺口、加速乌干达麻疹病毒消除的关键。

papers.title: Public Administration of Epidemiological Surveillance for Infectious Diseases in the Republic of Kazakhstan: Regulatory Compliance and Institutional Factors Associated with Measles Incidence
papers.abstract: Background: /Objectives: Strengthening public administration of epidemiological surveillance is a policy priority for the Republic of Kazakhstan amid globalization, the emergence of new pathogens, cross-border importation of quarantinable infections, and the high economic cost of recurrent epidemics. This study analyzed Kazakhstan’s sanitary-epidemiological legislation and evaluated the effectiveness of the public administration of its infectious disease surveillance system. Methods: We conducted a comparative analysis of current and repealed Kazakhstani legal acts against the World Health Organization International Health Regulations (2005), benchmarked against United States and Australian border-health law; a descriptive analysis of national infectious disease incidence per 100,000 population (2022–2024); and a multivariable ordinary least squares regression on a cross-sectional comparator sample of 12 countries (Kazakhstan, 10 Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development [OECD] member countries, and Romania, an OECD accession candidate; 2023–2024) relating log-transformed 2024 measles incidence to 2023 second-dose (MCV2) measles vaccination coverage and the 2023 World Bank Government Effectiveness index. Results: The legal analysis identified substantial gaps, including the absence of a statutory definition of epidemiological surveillance and of public health emergency criteria, and fragmented regulation of border sanitary control. Vaccine-preventable disease incidence rose sharply in 2023–2024 despite consistently high (98.8%) average official first-dose (MCV1) measles vaccination coverage. The regression model explained 68.3% of cross-country variance in measles incidence (R2 = 0.683; F(2,9) = 9.70; p = 0.006); government effectiveness was a significant predictor (B = −2.79; p = 0.007), whereas second-dose (MCV2) vaccination coverage was not (B = −0.03; p = 0.667). Conclusions: In the full-sample conventional OLS model, government effectiveness was associated with measles incidence whereas MCV2 coverage was not; however, this pattern was sensitive to the exclusion of Kazakhstan and to robust standard-error estimation, and should therefore be considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating rather than a confirmed determinant, given the small sample (n = 12). Kazakhstan should prioritize closing identified regulatory gaps and strengthening surveillance governance, informed by consolidated border-health models such as those of the United States and Australia.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the gaps in Kazakhstan's epidemiological surveillance system for measles, given the challenges posed by globalization, new pathogens, cross-border infections, and the economic burden of recurrent epidemics. The background highlights the need for strengthening public administration to ensure effective disease control.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved a comparative legal analysis of current and repealed Kazakhstani acts against WHO regulations, a descriptive analysis of measles incidence in Kazakhstan from 2022–2024, and a multivariable regression analysis of 12 countries, including Kazakhstan, 10 OECD members, and Romania, using 2023 vaccination data and government effectiveness indices.
analysis.methods: The researchers conducted a comparative legal analysis, benchmarked against US and Australian border-health laws, performed a descriptive analysis of national measles incidence rates, and applied a multivariable ordinary least squares regression model to correlate measles incidence with vaccination coverage and government effectiveness across 12 countries.
analysis.main_results: The legal analysis revealed significant gaps, such as the lack of a statutory definition for epidemiological surveillance and fragmented border sanitary control regulations. The regression model explained 68.3% of cross-country variance in measles incidence, with government effectiveness as a significant predictor (B = −2.79; p = 0.007), while MCV2 vaccination coverage was not (B = −0.03; p = 0.667).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that government effectiveness is a key factor influencing measles incidence, though the association was sensitive to the exclusion of Kazakhstan and robust standard-error estimation, indicating the need for further research. The study introduces a novel approach by linking legal frameworks and governance to disease incidence.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the importance of strengthening legal and institutional frameworks for epidemiological surveillance to improve disease control. They provide insights into how governance structures may impact public health outcomes, particularly in the context of measles prevention.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's small sample size (n = 12) and the sensitivity of findings to the exclusion of Kazakhstan limit the confidence in the conclusions. The evidence is exploratory and hypothesis-generating, with moderate strength due to the reliance on cross-sectional data and potential confounding factors.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the regulatory and institutional factors influencing measles incidence in Kazakhstan, focusing on the gaps in its epidemiological surveillance system. It compares Kazakhstan's legal framework with WHO standards and evaluates the effectiveness of its border health measures. The research employs a multivariable regression model to assess the relationship between measles incidence and vaccination coverage, alongside government effectiveness indices. Results indicate significant legal gaps and a potential link between government effectiveness and disease incidence, though the findings are exploratory due to the small sample size and sensitivity to data exclusion. The study underscores the need for improved governance and legal structures to enhance public health outcomes. It also highlights the importance of benchmarking against international models to strengthen surveillance systems.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决哈萨克斯坦在流行病学监测系统方面存在的差距,鉴于全球化、新病原体、跨境感染以及反复疫情的经济负担所带来的挑战。背景强调了加强公共管理以确保有效疾病控制的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究包括对现行和已废止的哈萨克斯坦法律与世界卫生组织法规的比较法律分析,对2022年至2024年哈萨克斯坦全国麻疹 发病率的描述性分析,以及对包括哈萨克斯坦、10个经济合作与发展组织(OECD)成员国和罗马尼亚(OECD候选国)在内的12个国家的多变量回归分析,使用2023年疫苗接种数据和政府效能指数。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员进行了比较法律分析,与美国和澳大利亚的边境健康法律进行基准比较,对全国麻疹 发病率的发病率进行了描述性分析,并应用了多变量普通最小二乘回归模型,以关联12个国家的麻疹 发病率与疫苗接种覆盖率和政府效能指数。
elements_zh.main_results: 法律分析揭示了显著的差距,例如缺乏流行病学监测的法定定义和公共卫生紧急情况标准,以及边境卫生控制的分散监管。回归模型解释了12个国家间麻疹 发病率的68.3%变异(R2 = 0.683;F(2,9) = 9.70;p = 0.006),其中政府效能是一个显著的预测因子(B = −2.79;p = 0.007),而MCV2 疫苗接种覆盖率则不显著(B = −0.03;p = 0.667)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,政府效能是影响麻疹 发病率的关键因素,尽管该关联在排除哈萨克斯坦和使用稳健标准误差估计时较为敏感,这表明需要进一步研究。本研究通过将法律框架和治理与疾病发病率联系起来,引入了一种新颖的方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果突显了加强流行病学监测法律和制度框架的重要性,以提高疾病控制效果。它们提供了关于治理结构如何影响公共卫生结果的见解,特别是在麻疹预防的背景下。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于样本量较小(n = 12)以及研究结果对排除哈萨克斯坦和使用稳健标准误差估计的敏感性,研究结论的信心受到限制。证据具有探索性和假设生成性,强度中等,这是由于依赖横断面数据和潜在的混杂因素。

analysis_en.main_results: The legal analysis revealed significant gaps, such as the lack of a statutory definition for epidemiological surveillance and fragmented border sanitary control regulations. The regression model explained 68.3% of cross-country variance in measles incidence, with government effectiveness as a significant predictor (B = −2.79; p = 0.007), while MCV2 vaccination coverage was not (B = −0.03; p = 0.667).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that government effectiveness is a key factor influencing measles incidence, though the association was sensitive to the exclusion of Kazakhstan and robust standard-error estimation, indicating the need for further research. The study introduces a novel approach by linking legal frameworks and governance to disease incidence.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the importance of strengthening legal and institutional frameworks for epidemiological surveillance to improve disease control. They provide insights into how governance structures may impact public health outcomes, particularly in the context of measles prevention.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's small sample size (n = 12) and the sensitivity of findings to the exclusion of Kazakhstan limit the confidence in the conclusions. The evidence is exploratory and hypothesis-generating, with moderate strength due to the reliance on cross-sectional data and potential confounding factors.

papers.title_zh: 哈萨克斯坦共和国传染病流行病学监测的公共管理:与监测相关的监管合规性和制度因素
papers.source_body_en: Background: /Objectives: Strengthening public administration of epidemiological surveillance is a policy priority for the Republic of Kazakhstan amid globalization, the emergence of new pathogens, cross-border importation of quarantinable infections, and the high economic cost of recurrent epidemics. This study analyzed Kazakhstan’s sanitary-epidemiological legislation and evaluated the effectiveness of the public administration of its infectious disease surveillance system. Methods: We conducted a comparative analysis of current and repealed Kazakhstani legal acts against the World Health Organization International Health Regulations (2005), benchmarked against United States and Australian border-health law; a descriptive analysis of national infectious disease incidence per 100,000 population (2022–2024); and a multivariable ordinary least squares regression on a cross-sectional comparator sample of 12 countries (Kazakhstan, 10 Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development [OECD] member countries, and Romania, an OECD accession candidate; 2023–2024) relating log-transformed 2024 measles incidence to 2023 second-dose (MCV2) measles vaccination coverage and the 2023 World Bank Government Effectiveness index. Results: The legal analysis identified substantial gaps, including the absence of a statutory definition of epidemiological surveillance and of public health emergency criteria, and fragmented regulation of border sanitary control. Vaccine-preventable disease incidence rose sharply in 2023–2024 despite consistently high (98.8%) average official first-dose (MCV1) measles vaccination coverage. The regression model explained 68.3% of cross-country variance in measles incidence (R2 = 0.683; F(2,9) = 9.70; p = 0.006); government effectiveness was a significant predictor (B = −2.79; p = 0.007), whereas second-dose (MCV2) vaccination coverage was not (B = −0.03; p = 0.667). Conclusions: In the full-sample conventional OLS model, government effectiveness was associated with measles incidence whereas MCV2 coverage was not; however, this pattern was sensitive to the exclusion of Kazakhstan and to robust standard-error estimation, and should therefore be considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating rather than a confirmed determinant, given the small sample (n = 12). Kazakhstan should prioritize closing identified regulatory gaps and strengthening surveillance governance, informed by consolidated border-health models such as those of the United States and Australia.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决哈萨克斯坦在流行病学监测系统方面存在的差距,鉴于全球化、新病原体、跨境感染以及反复疫情的经济负担所带来的挑战。背景强调了加强公共管理以确保有效疾病控制的必要性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究包括对现行和已废止的哈萨克斯坦法律与世界卫生组织法规的比较法律分析,对2022年至2024年哈萨克斯坦全国麻疹 发病率的描述性分析,以及对包括哈萨克斯坦、10个经济合作与发展组织(OECD)成员国和罗马尼亚(OECD候选国)在内的12个国家的多变量回归分析,使用2023年疫苗接种数据和政府效能指数。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员进行了比较法律分析,与美国和澳大利亚的边境健康法律进行基准比较,对全国麻疹 发病率的发病率进行了描述性分析,并应用了多变量普通最小二乘回归模型,以关联12个国家的麻疹 发病率与疫苗接种覆盖率和政府效能指数。
analysis_zh.main_results: 法律分析揭示了显著的差距,例如缺乏流行病学监测的法定定义和公共卫生紧急情况标准,以及边境卫生控制的分散监管。回归模型解释了12个国家间麻疹 发病率的68.3%变异(R2 = 0.683;F(2,9) = 9.70;p = 0.006),其中政府效能是一个显著的预测因子(B = −2.79;p = 0.007),而MCV2 疫苗接种覆盖率则不显著(B = −0.03;p = 0.667)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,政府效能是影响麻疹 发病率的关键因素,尽管该关联在排除哈萨克斯坦和使用稳健标准误差估计时较为敏感,这表明需要进一步研究。本研究通过将法律框架和治理与疾病发病率联系起来,引入了一种新颖的方法。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果突显了加强流行病学监测法律和制度框架的重要性,以提高疾病控制效果。它们提供了关于治理结构如何影响公共卫生结果的见解,特别是在麻疹预防的背景下。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于样本量较小(n = 12)以及研究结果对排除哈萨克斯坦和使用稳健标准误差估计的敏感性,研究结论的信心受到限制。证据具有探索性和假设生成性,强度中等,这是由于依赖横断面数据和潜在的混杂因素。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the resurgence of measles in Europe and its implications for public health, highlighting the need to understand the factors contributing to this trend and its impact on disease control.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is an editorial analyzing the resurgence of measles in Europe, focusing on the historical context and current public health challenges related to the disease.
analysis.methods: The editorial reviews existing literature and reports on measles resurgence, discussing epidemiological trends, vaccination coverage, and public health responses without detailing specific methodologies or statistical analyses.
analysis.main_results: The editorial reports that measles has resurged in Europe, with a notable increase in cases and outbreaks, particularly in regions with declining vaccination rates.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the resurgence as a public health setback, emphasizing the importance of maintaining high vaccination coverage to prevent outbreaks and the need for improved surveillance and response strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the necessity of sustained vaccination efforts and enhanced public health surveillance to mitigate measles resurgence and protect vulnerable populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on an editorial, which may have limited empirical data, but the analysis is grounded in well-established epidemiological trends and public health literature, supporting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This editorial addresses the resurgence of measles in Europe, highlighting its public health implications. The study emphasizes the need to understand the factors contributing to this trend, such as declining vaccination rates, and underscores the importance of maintaining high immunization coverage to prevent outbreaks. The authors interpret the resurgence as a setback for disease control, advocating for improved surveillance and response strategies. While the evidence is based on an editorial, it draws on established epidemiological data, providing a moderate confidence assessment. The findings inform public health actions to combat measles resurgence and reinforce the role of vaccination in preventing transmission.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the resurgence of measles in Europe and its implications for public health, highlighting the need to understand the factors contributing to this trend and its impact on disease control.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study is an editorial analyzing the resurgence of measles in Europe, focusing on the historical context and current public health challenges related to the disease.
elements_en.methods: The editorial reviews existing literature and reports on measles resurgence, discussing epidemiological trends, vaccination coverage, and public health responses without detailing specific methodologies or statistical analyses.
elements_en.main_results: The editorial reports that measles has resurged in Europe, with a notable increase in cases and outbreaks, particularly in regions with declining vaccination rates.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the resurgence as a public health setback, emphasizing the importance of maintaining high vaccination coverage to prevent outbreaks and the need for improved surveillance and response strategies.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the necessity of sustained vaccination efforts and enhanced public health surveillance to mitigate measles resurgence and protect vulnerable populations.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on an editorial, which may have limited empirical data, but the analysis is grounded in well-established epidemiological trends and public health literature, supporting a moderate confidence assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨麻疹在欧洲的再次流行及其对公共卫生的影响,强调了解导致这一趋势的因素及其对疾病控制的影响的重要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一篇编辑评论,分析麻疹在欧洲的再次流行,重点探讨该疾病的流行病学背景及当前公共卫生挑战。
elements_zh.methods: 该评论综述了现有文献和关于麻疹再次流行的相关报告,讨论了流行病学趋势、疫苗接种覆盖率以及公共卫生应对措施,但未详细描述具体的方法或统计分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 该评论指出,麻疹在欧洲出现了再次流行,病例数和暴发显著增加,尤其是在疫苗接种率下降的地区。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此次再次流行视为公共卫生的挫折,强调保持高疫苗接种覆盖率以防止暴发的重要性,并指出需要改进监测和应对策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明需要持续进行疫苗接种工作,并加强公共卫生监测,以减轻麻疹再次流行的影响并保护易感人群。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该证据基于一篇编辑评论,可能缺乏实证数据,但分析建立在公认的流行病学趋势和公共卫生文献之上,支持中等程度的可信度评估。

papers.title: Detecting measles virus in hospital air during a local outbreak
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In 2024, Chicago experienced a measles virus outbreak. Air samples collected as part of routine respiratory virus surveillance from three hospitals that received measles patients were retrospectively analyzed. Measles virus was detected in air samples from one emergency department across five weeks when measles patients were present and another when no known cases were present. Two of three viral sequences derived from air samples were identical to measles outbreak patients. The source of one diverging sequence could not be identified and may represent a case not identified by traditional surveillance methods. Air sampling may supplement measles investigation, surveillance and response.

Measles virus was detected in air samples from one emergency department across five weeks when measles patients were present and another when no known cases were present. Two of three viral sequences derived from air samples were identical to measles outbreak patients. The source of one diverging sequence could not be identified and may represent a case not identified by traditional surveillance methods. Air sampling may supplement measles investigation, surveillance and response.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the presence of measles virus in hospital air during an outbreak and to assess its potential role in transmission.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Air samples were collected from three hospitals during a measles outbreak in Chicago in 2024, specifically from an emergency department and another where no known cases were present.
analysis.methods: Retrospective analysis of air samples was conducted as part of routine respiratory virus surveillance, with viral sequences derived from these samples compared to those from measles outbreak patients.
analysis.main_results: Measles virus was detected in air samples from one emergency department during the five-week period when measles patients were present, and in another setting when no known cases were present. Two of the three viral sequences from the air samples matched measles outbreak patients.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that measles virus may be present in hospital air, potentially indicating airborne transmission, and highlight the possibility of undetected cases through traditional surveillance methods.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform improved measles surveillance strategies and highlight the importance of air sampling in identifying transmission risks in healthcare settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and the lack of real-time data, but the evidence is moderate as it directly links viral sequences from air samples to measles outbreak patients.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the presence of measles virus in hospital air during a 2024 outbreak in Chicago. Air samples were collected from three hospitals, including an emergency department where measles patients were present and another where no known cases were present. Retrospective analysis revealed measles virus in the air samples from the emergency department and one other location, with two of three viral sequences matching those from outbreak patients. The findings suggest that measles virus may be detectable in hospital air, potentially indicating airborne transmission, and highlight the possibility of undetected cases through traditional surveillance methods. These results may inform improved measles surveillance strategies and emphasize the importance of air sampling in identifying transmission risks in healthcare settings. The study is limited by its retrospective nature, but the evidence is moderate due to the direct comparison of viral sequences from air samples to outbreak patients.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查在暴发期间医院空气中是否存在麻疹病毒,并评估其在传播中的潜在作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在2024年芝加哥发生的麻疹 暴发期间,从三家医院收集了空气样本,具体包括一个急诊科和一个没有已知病例的区域。
elements_zh.methods: 作为常规呼吸道病毒监测的一部分,对空气样本进行了回顾性分析,并将这些样本中的病毒序列与麻疹 暴发患者的序列进行了比较。
elements_zh.main_results: 在麻疹患者存在的五周期间,空气样本中检测到了麻疹病毒,而在另一时间段没有已知病例时也检测到了该病毒。从空气样本中获得的三个病毒序列中有两个与麻疹 暴发患者的序列相同。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,麻疹病毒可能存在于医院空气中,可能提示空气传播的传播,并强调传统监测方法可能漏检病例的可能性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能有助于改进麻疹的监测策略,并突出空气采样在识别医疗环境中传播风险的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其回顾性设计以及缺乏实时数据,但证据中等,因为它直接将空气样本中的病毒序列与麻疹 暴发患者的序列联系起来。

papers.title: Potently neutralizing and protective human monoclonal antibodies against the measles fusion protein trimer.
papers.abstract: Measles remains a significant source of morbidity and mortality globally. There are currently no licensed treatments for patients at high risk of severe disease. There is limited knowledge about the human antibody response to a measles infection or vaccination or the structural determinants of antibody-mediated neutralization on the measles virus surface hemagglutinin (H) and fusion (F) glycoproteins. Here, we describe a panel of human monoclonal antibodies isolated from individuals who had been naturally infected with the measles virus. Several antibodies that recognized a prefusion-stabilized F protein potently neutralized the virus in vitro. We determined the structural basis of molecular recognition and virus neutralization using cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) for two antibodies that recognize distinct sites of the F protein, MeV-15 and MeV-104. These antibodies also strongly inhibited viral replication in vivo when administered prophylactically in a murine transgenic model and when administered therapeutically in a cotton rat model of established infection.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the human antibody response to measles virus infection, focusing on the structural basis of neutralization against the fusion (F) protein. The research highlights the potential of monoclonal antibodies to neutralize the virus in vitro and inhibit replication in animal models. These findings could contribute to the development of new therapeutic approaches for measles, especially for high-risk patients. However, the study is limited to in vitro and in vivo models, and the results are based on a single panel of antibodies, which may affect generalizability. The study provides novel insights into the molecular mechanisms of antibody-mediated neutralization, which could have implications for vaccine design and treatment strategies. The evidence is strong, but the lack of human clinical trials limits the confidence in its direct application to public health interventions.

papers.title: Nationwide Surveillance and Control Measures during Large Measles Outbreak, Bangladesh, 2026
papers.abstract: Nationwide surveillance in Bangladesh during April 2-May 27, 2026, identified a total of 67,079 suspected and 8,834 confirmed measles cases across 8 administrative divisions. Among suspected cases, 472 deaths were reported, and 88 deaths were reported among confirmed cases. Despite high reported vaccine coverage, transmission persisted amid residual immunity gaps. Vaccine stockouts, discontinued vaccination campaigns, and coverage overestimation likely contributed to Bangladesh's largest recorded measles outbreak.
